newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian coconut oil softens, copra down.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian coconut oil softens, copra down.

text.p: Indonesian coconut oil prices softened on Friday on prolonged poor demand also sparking a fall in copra prices, traders said.
They said coconut oil was quoted at 1,820-25 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, down from 1,820-30 rupiah/kg a week ago. Copra fell to 740 rupiah/kg from 800 rupiah/kg.

"Most players are still out of the market. Demand from refineries are poor, that's why the market is very quiet," one trader said. Traders said refineries seemed to already have enough stock and they bought copra only when needed.
Some traders said copra prices fell because supply was abundant, but added they expected prices would improve ahead of the Eid al-Adha celebration on April 18 when demand picked up.
Others said coconut oil prices fell perhaps because consumers had turned to olein, a subsitute vegetable oil, which was usually cheaper. Olein was on offer in Jakarta on Friday at 1,405 rupiah/kg.
Traders in Manila said on Monday coconut oil prices were expected to drift lower or remain steady this week due to rising supply from both the Philippines and Indonesia.
